5 A non-dependant deduction is not appropriate where the non-dependant is a full time student and the claimant or partner has reached the age of 65. From 6.12.18 this requirement is amended because, at this point in time, everyone on SPC will be over the SPA, consequently there is no need to have the additional provision which could apply for SPC claimants under 65 where their non-dep is a student1.
